name: code review
wording: of any change, not only code, by exactly one non-author, against its user story's acceptance criteria and examples, held-out ones included; a contrived way around a check is a finding on that check, not on the change
reason: Approving or naming findings is what the name already says, and never repairing is the reviewer's own value; that there is one reviewer is stated here once, no longer under Ship/Show/Ask, and held-out examples are named as part of what it judges against.
